about: The public site's gameplay media from the site fifty (owner, 2026-10-11: "replace the old media with all my new ones", after every set is done). tools/media-r5/site-media.mjs builds public/media/site50-r14 from these picks: the round's deliveries (each take's 4K loop, stills and sound), the fifty frames and the films. Slots name a take id and, for stills, which still: moment (the key moment) or close (the close portrait).

home.shots: The home page's own shots (home r2, 2026-10-12; owner: "update all of these images to use new shots that are a lot better! and add far more mechanics ... and make a new section highlighting all game modes with custom shots for all of them"). Each slot of features, mechanics and modes is delivered as <sources.home>/<group>/<id>.png (shots/media-r5/home-r2/shot-list.json says what it must show and how it is staged); site-media.mjs builds it into home/<group>/<id>.webp and site-media-wire.mjs points the slot at it. Until then the slot shows its stand-in, a site fifty still. The Studio card's loop is delivered as features/studio.webm with the recorder's manifest as features/studio.json.

alt.en: The Garage in the Verdant Motor Pool: a KF51 Panther on the pedestal with its armor card, equipment loadout and the vehicle carousel
alt.zh: 翠绿集结场里的车库：基座上的 KF51 Panther，旁边是它的装甲卡、装备配置与载具轮播

alt.en: Two players' live views from one room: a Challenger 3 and a T-90M Proryv aim at each other across the Tarkhan Steppe at sunset

alt.en: X-ray kill cam on Verdant Fields by day: a T-72B3M's 3BM46 APFSDS round is traced into an X-rayed T-90M Proryv through the upper left hull side for 449 damage, with the struck modules labelled, the ballistic-analysis card and the Destroyed By card.

studio.label: Scene Studio on Frontier Basin at golden hour with the Director workspace open: a Type 10 rolls toward the lens as the T-90M Proryv it knocked out explodes and burns behind it, beside the sequence library, the Stage Sequence button and the site's takes as cards.

standIn.label: Scene Studio interface staging and replaying a Stridsvagn 122 attack on a Leclerc

alt.en: Armor flashlight on Kestrel Airfield in the morning: through a Leopard 2A7V's sight at x16, a ZTZ-99A2 under a camouflage net 159 m away is painted green where the loaded APFSDS round penetrates and red on its turret top and hull front, where it does not.

alt.en: A shell ricochets off a T-90M Proryv's sloped glacis in a fan of sparks on the snow of Frosthollow

alt.en: M1A2 Abrams SEPv3 tanks and a Challenger 3 fire across the Tarkhan Steppe at golden hour, a tracer and an HE burst downrange

alt.en: Guided missile on Tarkhan Steppe at sunset: an MBT-70's Shillelagh streaks over the autumn grassland toward the lens, its glowing trail running back to the launch behind a low rise and its rocket motor flaring at the right.

home.newMedia: The landing page's new media (2026-10-19, the owner: "all our new medai has to be shhown soomewhhere", then "either way all oour new frames need to goo up with no removals of old ones"): the hero opens on six versus stills (public/media/versus-r1) before its six site fifty slides; the screenshot rail shows the combat round's four duels and seven of the 226/227 fleet takes before its eleven; the versus wall shows every versus still, the newest round first (2026-10-22, "we need all on the site!": round 7's close and top-down stills beside the earlier rounds'), under the versus films (versusFilms: each scene's moving take, public/media/versus-films-r1, muted loops that play in view); the trailers row plays the three trailers on a click. Every 226/227 fleet take is a site take (takes[id].fleet, its titles from the fleet roster), so its key moment and close portrait are published and join the visual archive.
